name: FocusX ESP32-S3 Dual-RFID Scanner Firmware V5.1.7 (Hardware PWM Buzzer & Unified Status LED Restored)
capabilities: restored dual PN532 SPI RFID readers on GPIO 10, 11, 12, 13, 14
restored hardware PWM buzzer on GPIO 8 for door alarms, nag alerts, and tap chimes
restored unified front & exit LED strips on GPIO 6 & 7 (solid Red on armed, solid Green on welcome, solid Orange on goodbye)
unregistered card push to dashboard & direct RFID assignment
reactive snapshot sync on serverAuthRevision in scan response
reed switch on GPIO 9 with internal pullup
virtual 16x2 LCD screen memory mirror & backlight shadowing
ephemeral 5-minute live peek accelerated sub-second screen streaming
heartbeat screen telemetry & diagnostic summary streaming
health-gated rollback commit (LittleFS, signed snapshot, dual PN532, free heap)
SHA-256 image stream validation & 0xE9 magic byte check
